visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Wrong Exception Is Caught
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Dividing by zero should print cannot divide by zero and return None, but the program crashes with a ZeroDivisionError.

solution.explanation: An except clause handles only the exception types it names. Dividing by zero raises ZeroDivisionError, which is not a ValueError, so it passes through uncaught (after finally has run).
